source.name: Sample fixture (fictional, not a real announcement)

text.en: Fictional sample event: mock reports of a large foreign fund adding to its holding lifted the fictional stock.
text.id: Peristiwa contoh fiksi: laporan pura-pura bahwa dana asing besar menambah kepemilikannya mengangkat saham fiktif ini.
text.zh: 虚构样本事件：一则关于大型外资基金增持的模拟报道推高了该虚构股票。

source.name: Sample fixture (fictional, not a real announcement)

text.en: Fictional sample report: the fictional issuer filed a mock half-year result with higher profit and a lower loan balance.
text.id: Laporan contoh fiksi: penerbit fiktif melaporkan hasil semester pura-pura dengan laba naik dan saldo pinjaman turun.
text.zh: 虚构样本报告：该虚构发行人提交模拟半年业绩，利润上升、贷款余额下降。
